text:
Leah: Quick sync 24h before we finalize the webinar runbook. Need to lock topic order, confirm speakers, and assign demo failover leads. Drop one-line ack or changes.

Tom: Prefer a compact keynote. Audience retention drops after long intros. 15/25/20?

Priya: 15/25/20 pls. More demo time to show real cost + latency comparisons.

Ravi: fine with that. I'll own the demo failover toggle and script.

Ava: Speakers: Sarah and Miguel are confirmed. Oliver said yes in DMs but hasn't uploaded slides. I'll chase and request slide deck by Wed noon.

Ethan: I'll moderate the panel and handle Q->SDR routing. Confirming SFDC campaign is "webinar-march-26". Ops, can you confirm reg->SFDC mapping?

Ops: Confirmed. Zoom regs map to the campaign. We will tag leads with "interest_level" and "demo_click". Recording retention set to 90 days unless legal asks otherwise.

Leah: Draft run-of-show (minutes from start):
```
0:00 - 0:02  Welcome + housekeeping (Leah)
0:02 - 0:17  Keynote: cost-aware inference (Sarah)
0:17 - 0:42  Live demo: Dedicated vs Hosted (Miguel + Ravi)
0:42 - 0:56  Panel: architecting for latency & cost (Oliver, Sarah, Miguel)
0:56 - 1:00  Close + CTA + lead routing (Leah + Ethan)
```
Switch keynote to 15m if we go 15/25/20 and adjust timings.

Tom: Add a 2-min poll after keynote (PoC / Scaling / Security) to help routing.

Priya: Also recommend a fixed 50-token prompt for demo so we can repeat and show latency/cost numbers. I'll post the prompt + expected outputs.

Ravi: Demo failover plan summary:
1) Primary: Dedicated pool (show throughput + latency)
2) On timeout/error: flip to Hosted quantized model (degraded but ok)
3) If region issue: fallback to EU region with warm KV cache
I will create a small toggle script we can flip from greenroom. Also will include a 1-line scrub step to clear logs/keys pre-demo.

Ava: Rehearsal slots: tech check (30m) 2 days before, full dress (60m) 1 day before, final mic check (15m) 1h before. Proposed times:
- Tue 4:00pm PT: tech check
- Wed 9:00am PT: full dress
- Thu 9:45am PT: final mic check (live 10am PT)
Miguel: can't make Tue morning but ok for Wed + Thu.

Ethan: Lead routing detail: after poll + demo CTA, "request demo" clicks route to SDR queue A if ARR > 100k else SDR queue B. Need hidden ARR band on reg form. Ops, can SFDC map?

Ops: Yes, we'll create queues and map by "arr_band" field. Demo clicks logged as activity, campaign assigned.

Priya: Marketing ask: can design produce a single-page benchmark infographic for slides + landing? I'll provide numbers.

Ava: Yes, will produce long + compact versions for slide and social. Deliverable by Mon EOD.

Tom: Compliance: speakers must sign recording consent. Demos use synthetic data only. Oliver needs to approve.

Leah: I'll send consent form to speakers. All demos must use synthetic datasets; Ravi to scrub any env-sensitive info pre-demo.

Outstanding actions:
- Ava: design infographic + chase Oliver slides (Mon EOD)
- Priya: demo prompt + expected outputs (Fri)
- Ravi: failover toggle + scrub script (Wed)
- Ethan: panel moderation + confirm lead routing (with Ops)
- Ops: SFDC queues + form mapping (Tue)
- All speakers: sign consent + upload slides (Wed noon)

Tom: ack

Priya: ack 24 will post prompt in #marketing-assets when ready.

Ravi: ack 24 pushing script to /rehearsals/demo-fallbacks and will ping.

Ava: ack 24 looping in design now.

Ethan: ack

Leah: Thanks all. Calendar invites for rehearsal + dress are incoming. :sparkles:

ZoomBot: Recording scheduled for 2026-03-26 10:00 PT. Link: https://zoom.us/rec/abc123 (access restricted to org).
